records.title: A modifier value agrees with one selected argument class
An exception marker scopes to one field and then releases

IDEA000064.missing_observation: The design names neither a written modifier form nor its proposed alternative, neither a designated argument surface class nor an observed matched change. Its sentence “holding the modifier constant ... force the modifier alternation” also needs disambiguation: semantic feature can be held fixed while written realization changes; the written form cannot simultaneously be fixed and alternate.
IDEA000064.actual_nearest_source: GDT577 G407-E3605 has D_ADDR+CH+E+O+K+E+D_ADDR+Y; E and D_ADDR are paired with the same two analytical heads. G407-E0491 has CH+E+T+E+LOCAL_CHAR_G. Both provide repeated modifier slots across different heads, but no observed two-form agreement alternation with a changing designated class. Seventy-five old focus bindings are replayed; fifty O/D_ADDR attachments are newly hypothesized.
IDEA000064.decision: Do not run a modifier-class classifier on these inferred bindings and call its score agreement. A purely structural test is possible once a named raw-form alternation and an observed carrier substitution are specified; semantic gold is not needed for that structural comparison.

IDEA000066.missing_observation: No exception-marker surface is nominated, and no actual record shows the proposed default–override–default sequence for a fixed observable target feature. Thus neither the treatment position nor the putative release can be extracted without inventing the candidate after observing outcomes.
IDEA000066.actual_nearest_source: GDT765 f22r.4/5 prints ofchy daiin ... schor daiin and ol daiin ... dar daiin, and calls cfhy a local transition. These are concrete complete-form positions, but all four printed right members are the same daiin. There is no displayed altered field value followed by a return value; cfhy as a semantic exception is not demonstrated. Known DY local scope supplies no new discriminator for this distinct proposal.
IDEA000066.decision: Do not infer one-field exception from an interpreted transition or ordinary variation among neighboring fields.

strongest_concrete_alternative.observation: Use the named f22r repeated X daiin cells as a starting observation, retaining complete forms and reported loci rather than semantic head labels.
strongest_concrete_alternative.potential_question: A prospective structural selector could ask whether a nominated non-DY intervening form is followed by a temporary change in a specified written field feature that reverts at the next eligible field, versus persistent change. Freeze marker, feature and eligible sequence before inspecting outcomes.
strongest_concrete_alternative.why_not_run_now: The cited example has no temporary change; it therefore supplies no override/release contrast. The existing source does not identify another contrasting record. Merely counting more X daiin cells or inventing a generic exception model would leave the research decision unchanged. This is an unavailable observation specification, not a new experiment recommendation.

source_audit.quote:
## Was schon fest war und was neu vorgeschlagen wird

75 Slots — 71 aus den alten 26 Seiten und vier aus den neueren vier Seiten —
besitzen bereits Fokusbindungen für E, EE oder AR. GDT577 reproduziert alle
75 exakt.

Die 50 O-/D_ADDR-Slots hatten solche Bindungen bisher nicht. Für sie wird
explorativ dieselbe lokale Werkstattlogik angewandt:

- 21 stehen nach dem nächstgelegenen sichtbaren Handlungskopf;
- 14 stehen vor ihm;
- 14 gehören zum schon aktiven Besitzerkopf;
- genau einer, das zweite D_ADDR in `G407-E3030`, gehört zum geschriebenen
  OL-Fortsetzungsträger.

Das ist ein Anschlussmodell für die deutsche Arbeitsstimme, keine neue
Bedeutung von O oder D_ADDR.

## Konkrete Lesefolgen

`G407-E0491 · CH+E+T+E+LOCAL_CHAR_G`

```text
CH → E    und    T → E
Nehmen auf Grad I; Einstellen ebenfalls auf Grad I.
```

Die beiden Grade hängen an zwei verschiedenen Handlungen. Ein globales
„Grad I zweimal“ wäre weniger informativ.

`G407-E0607 · O+P+O+AM_ADDR`

```text
O → P → erneut O → AM_ADDR
```

Hier umklammern beide O-Slots denselben P-Kopf. Die Arbeitsstimme darf diese
Folge aussprechen, soll aber O keine zusätzliche Prozessdefinition geben.

`G407-E3030 · D_ADDR+SH+OL+Y+D_ADDR`

```text
D-Stelle → Halten; OL → wieder D-Stelle
```

Das ist der einzige gemischte Handlung/Fortsetzung-Fall.

`G407-E3605 · D_ADDR+CH+E+O+K+E+D_ADDR+Y`

E und D_ADDR benutzen dieselben zwei lokalen Köpfe CH und K. Solche
überlappenden Gruppen werden auf Ereignisebene einmal gemeinsam gerendert,
nicht zweimal unabhängig übereinandergelegt.

## Ein nützlicher Fehlerfund

## The f22r record now says something

The first two lines of the local paragraph contain four exact value cells:

```text
f22r.4  ofchy daiin  ...  schor daiin
f22r.5  ol daiin     ...  dar daiin
```

Across the entire cache there are twelve exact `H-head X daiin` triples
(H1 five, H2 five, H4 two); f22r.4 alone contains two on one line. That makes a
main-field/subfield inventory much more natural than a sequence of actions.

The deliberately concrete f22r.4 working translation is:

> Haupteintrag, Trockenklasse III: drei Einheiten Blütenmasse; abgemessene
> Drogenportion Form III mit dazugehörigem Trockenmaterial; Unterposten: drei
> Einheiten Blütenstand.

This line covers all nine written tokens. The central `cfhy` now acts locally
as a field transition. It occurs reader-exact six times, five medial and once
line-final, never at paragraph end and never directly before `daiin`; the old
“take,” “wring,” and free cfh/flower readings are not used. `doroiin` and
`ypchol` retain explicit C0 local defaults, so this is a complete working
reading rather than a claim of recovered plaintext.

The amount wording is also a choice. The portable form remains “value III”
because `daiin` can still be class, degree, or amount. The concrete f22 renderer
chooses three units because four neighboring material/preparation heads make
an inventory or recipe quantity list plausible.

workflow_decision: Keep both as unreviewed raw sketches. No new model, null corpus, tests or data admission. One future bounded source-observation nomination would change availability; repeated generic missing-gold reviews will not.
limits: Read-only source selection, no manuscript data extraction, native image access, public approach search or registry mutation. Sources were returned by route-check. Structural confirmation would not identify agreement, exception or any word meaning.
